fusions.name: Mud Gob
fusions.desc: Spits a gob of mud that deals 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Flycatcher's Reach
fusions.desc: A lash at full stretch that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles, and stuns the target for 0.8 seconds. Anything struck moves 30% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sprung from the Bank
fusions.desc: Carries you 4 tiles forward and raises your movement speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Spadefoot's Burrow
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 30%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
